description: Allowance check on Arc before an approval: what owner already approved to spender (default USDC), unlimited or not, in USD, the owner balance, the spender name if it is a contract we know (never guessed), risk signals. A non-token is refused before payment. $0.001 per call over x402 (USDC on Arc, Base or Solana, or XNT on X1). Call once without `payment` for the terms, sign them with your own wallet, call again with `payment`.

payment.description: a signed x402 payment (the base64 payload you would put in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE). Pass it and the purchase completes inside this tool call.

name: arc_allowance
